name: Asparagus Soup with Chicken Slices & Garlicky Grape Tomatoes

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash the asparagus and snap (or cut) off the woody ends. Cut off about 2 inches of the tips and reserve in a bowl. Chop the remaining stalks into 1 inch pieces.
Peel and thinly slice the shallots into rings. Peel and mince the garlic.
Heat a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add butter to the saucepan and swirl to coat bottom. Add reserved asparagus tips and cook until slightly softened, 2-3 minutes. Transfer back to the bowl and set aside.

Once tips have been removed, add more butter to the saucepan followed by asparagus stalks, shallots, and garlic. Season with salt and pepper. Increase heat to medium-high and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp butter, unsalted
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the spinach; set aside.
Wash the tomatoes. Peel and mince the remaining garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ pint grape tomatoes
2 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Slice the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add oil to skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Add spinach to the asparagus and mix. Pour in the broth and bring to a boil. Turn heat off and purée with a hand (immersion) blender.
instructions.secondary_message: 12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Add olive oil and garlic to the skillet; cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Reduce heat to low. Add the tomatoes and vinegar; cook, stirring frequently, until the vinegar has thickened slightly and the tomatoes have begun to burst, 4-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar

instructions.primary_message: Slice chicken on an angle into bite-sized strips.
To serve, pour soup into a bowl, scatter the asparagus tips over top, and season with additional salt and pepper if desired. Place chicken slices on the side and top with tomatoes. Enjoy!
